steps.name: Start up
steps.what: Business case, approvals and assurance plan, risk assessment and budget.
steps.dealWith: Project board and senior responsible owner
steps.wait: A few weeks for spend control

steps.name: Equality and sustainability
steps.what: Equality analysis and sustainability assessment. Both are updated again in alpha.

steps.name: Gate 1: business justification
steps.what: The project board decides whether the case for the service is strong enough to go on.
steps.owner: Project board and senior responsible owner
steps.wait: Decided at the next project board

steps.name: Architecture approval
steps.what: Write a solution overview and present it to the design authority.

steps.name: Data protection
steps.what: Full data protection impact assessment.

steps.name: Full business case and whole life costs
steps.what: Full business case with whole life costs.
steps.wait: 6 to 8 weeks to book an assessment

steps.name: Algorithmic transparency record
steps.what: Publish a record of how the service uses AI, under the Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard.

steps.name: Cloud platform onboarding
steps.what: Onboard the service to the cloud platform team's Azure platform.

steps.name: Cloud design review board
steps.what: Present the design to the cloud platform team's review board.

steps.name: Gate 2: delivery strategy
steps.what: Only when third-party suppliers deliver part of the service. The board agrees how it will be delivered and bought.
steps.owner: Project board and senior responsible owner
steps.wait: Decided at the next project board

steps.name: Gate 3: investment decision
steps.what: The board decides whether to invest in building the service.
steps.owner: Project board and senior responsible owner
steps.wait: Decided at the next project board

steps.name: Alpha service assessment
steps.what: A panel assesses the service against the Service Standard.

steps.name: Service design approval
steps.what: GRIP, then the Service Design Pack. The Service Design Review Board approves readiness.
steps.wait: About 12 weeks, with a 2-week expert review inside it

steps.name: IT health check
steps.what: A penetration test by an approved supplier, with a report and fixes.

steps.name: Platform Readiness Review
steps.what: The CDP platform team checks the service is ready to run on the platform.

steps.name: Accessibility audit
steps.what: An independent audit against WCAG 2.2 AA, with fixes and an accessibility statement.

steps.name: Gate 4: service readiness
steps.what: The board decides whether the service is ready to go live.
steps.owner: Project board and senior responsible owner
steps.wait: Decided at the next project board

steps.name: Beta service assessment
steps.what: A panel assesses the service before it opens to everyone.

steps.name: Change request and release
steps.what: Raise a change request. The change board approves the release.

steps.name: Closure
steps.what: Test completion report and closure report.

steps.name: Gate 5: closure
steps.what: The board closes the project. The service lives on with its operations team.
steps.owner: Project board and senior responsible owner
steps.wait: Decided at the next project board

steps.name: Live service assessment
steps.what: A panel assesses the live service.
